tagline: Accessible walking routes that find the shade
brief: A route planner for Astana's hot summers. A person with disabilities gets one barrier-free route to the door; SAYA decides with A*, Bayes and an MDP whether a shadier detour is worth it today. Сая is Kazakh for shade.
criteria: Success: says shade at a glance, distinct from the green and red of map apps, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, matches the landing page.

concepts.name: Into the shade
concepts.idea: A route walks into the shade of a crown and turns light there.
rationale: Says the name: Сая is shade, as in саябақ, park
The route is cut out of the shade: a real hole, so it survives one colour, reversed and 16 px
Steppe-sky teal from the landing page, apart from the green and red of map apps
Monoline wordmark with round ends and no sharp corners: barrier-free letters

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup in headers, the symbol alone for icons and avatars, and the small cut below 48 px.
next_steps: Put favicon.svg and the web icons into site/ and the app's web/
Use the horizontal lockup in the README header and the landing page
Run a trademark search before any public launch
